name: @funcd/example-blob-object
description: A funcd blob example (ADR-0127): a function that put/get/lists objects NATIVELY via context.blob (bind-as-grant, no S3 keypair). Authored in TypeScript against @funcd/shim-nodejs; the contract build generates the JSON Schema from FuncInput/FuncOutput, bakes an eval-free validator, and emits object.mjs + the schema files.
